body:
## Problem

`packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `gene-hoglan` entry (Death "Individual Thought Patterns" 1993 era), `setup.sticks` block (lines 772-786):
```
sticks: {
  item: 'Pro-Mark 747 Oak',
  model: 'Rock model',
  specs: 'Oak, wood tip, .551" diameter',
  originalPrice: 8,
  year: 1993,
  source: 'Standard retail price',
  notes: 'Heavy oak for power and durability. Hoglan\'s aggressive technique requires robust sticks.',
  ...
},
```
This is a distinct field from #7335 (already fixed the same entry's cymbals field — a 1993 "Zildjian A Series" fabrication, corrected to Sabian AAX since 1991) and #7055 (already fixed this entry's drums field — Pearl→Tama at line 728). Neither prior fix touched the sticks field, which still fabricates a Pro-Mark signing 25 years before the verified date.

## Verified (internal source of truth)

`packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js`, `gene-hoglan` timeline:
```
{ year: 2018, changeType: SIGNED, category: STICKS, from: null, to: 'ProMark',
  notes: 'Settled on ProMark Classic Forward 2B sticks for his Pearl Reference Pure setup of that era, favoring their balance across marathon touring and clinic schedules' },
```
`currentEndorsements.sticks: { brand: 'ProMark', model: 'Classic Forward 2B', since: '2018' }` — a `from: null` first-ever signing. No stick brand is documented anywhere in the record before 2018, let alone in 1993.

## Fix

In `packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `gene-hoglan` `setup.sticks` block (1993 entry): omit the specific brand claim per the verified-only/omit-if-unsure rule, since no stick brand is documented for the 1993 Individual Thought Patterns era — do not substitute a guessed brand. Update `notes` to describe generic/unbranded sticks if the field must remain populated, or mark as unconfirmed.

## Verify
- [ ] `grep -n "Pro-Mark 747 Oak" packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js` within the gene-hoglan 1993 setup block returns zero hits
- [ ] The 1993 sticks field no longer asserts a specific brand undocumented until 2018
- [ ] Drums (already fixed by #7055) and cymbals (already fixed by #7335) fields left untouched

## Done
`gearPriceHistory.js`'s `gene-hoglan` 1993 `setup.sticks` field no longer fabricates a ProMark signing 25 years before the verified 2018 date; zero new pages/URLs.
title: SEO: Gene Hoglan gearPriceHistory.js 1993 setup.sticks claims Pro-Mark 747 Oak — verified ProMark wasn't signed until 2018
